topic.title: [Other feedback] Where can Kaggle AI be applied?
topic.content: I noticed that Kaggle offers an additional option called "ai": Daily: $10.00 out of a total of $10.00. How is this used? Is it related to the API for model inference?

comments.content:
Yup the quota is for model inference for Kaggle Benchmarks: https://www.kaggle.com/benchmarks

You basically get access to a bunch of SOTA models from different providers: Deepmind, Anthropic, Deepseek, Qwen, etc. that you can use to build benchmarks! Learn more here: https://www.kaggle.com/docs/benchmarks

Lmk if you've more qs!
I'm not sure , but most probably it's for benchmark :)
